title: Derived Hom from a finite locally free sheaf
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme and let $P$ be an $\mathcal O_Y$-module that is locally isomorphic to $\mathcal O_Y^{\oplus d}$ on an open cover, with the finite ranks $d$ locally constant [def-pc-scheme]. Let $L$ be an $\mathcal O_Y$-module viewed in degree zero [def-pc-derived-category]. Then $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(P,L)$ is represented by the sheaf $\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(P,L)$ in degree zero; equivalently, the sheaves $\mathcal E xt^i_{\mathcal O_Y}(P,L)$ vanish for every $i>0$.
